 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.20/2023, dated 18.1.2023, registered at Police Station Belkheda District Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 450, 376, 376(2)d),376(2)(N), 323, 506 of IPC .
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Rohit Rajak is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after receipt of DNA report.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Rohit Rajak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65821427/
